statements.text: Big Tech should pay their own way. They have the money. This should not be put on the consumers under any circumstances. [...] They need to pay the energy costs. They need to pay for the water, and the local communities are the ones to decide whether or not they want that in their backyard.
statements.venue: League of Women Voters online candidate forum for FL-16, reported by WUSF

statements.text: He may be against AI and against data centers, but yet (he is) personally profiting from them. This is just another example of why people are fed up with Congress. I am committed to banning stock trading for this very purpose.
statements.venue: FL-16 candidate forum, reported by Tampa Bay Times (via ArcaMax)
